label: Joint raw-log-return shared-one-block path distribution and fitted-Q policy - live transition fine-tuning - 33 exposures - 64-epoch gamma/friction curriculum

transition.representation: for every one of 15 marginals concatenate all 32 probabilities, all 32 learned component return values in bps, expectation, and entropy; append log causal scale

architecture.network: trainable shared-one-block path distribution; one GNGLU maps its complete distribution to a shared 256-value state; one live-gradient linear head emits post-rebalance Q-bar for every exposure

rl.reward: exact log wealth: rebalance friction plus passive holding return
rl.portfolioTransition: exact marked-exposure drift after each realized active return
rl.counterfactualActions: every historical transition supervises all 33 actions
rl.target: Double-Q action selection with Polyak target evaluation; validation selection always uses final gamma and friction

selection.testPolicy: sealed until the best target-schedule validation checkpoint is selected
